description: Stable 1.6.4 core with scoped dev jogging and pendant overlays; not a full dev build.

overlays.purpose: Jog streamer, joystick and jog controls
Pendant interface and required helpers; plugin-only tools excluded because stable core does not have plugin support. Pendant theme and rapid-position helpers isolated under src/pendant.

compatibilityNotes: Stable connection/bundler hooks updated without changing controller USB ownership.
Pendant preference, console clear action and existing parking-function export added to stable shared UI.
Two upstream jog tests updated for the current ASSUMED_ACCEL=1000 constant; runtime jog algorithm kept from pinned dev.
Android ownership guard prevents new jog streams taking outstanding knob ACKs.
Existing Android USB, native haptics, fixed viewport, XY mode switch, and automatic knob readiness retained.
